#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long brute1(long long m) {
    long long ans = 6 * (m / 6);
    if (m % 6 == 5) ans += 4;
    else if (m % 6 == 4) ans += 2;
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    long long n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    if (m < n) swap(n, m);

    if (n == 1) {
        cout << brute1(m) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    if (n == 2) {
        if (m < 3) cout << 0 << '\n';
        else if (m == 3) cout << 4 << '\n';
        else if (m == 7) cout << 12 << '\n';
        else cout << 2 * m << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    // general case
    cout << 2 * (n * m / 2) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
